description: This source file defines FastAPI routes and utility functions related to OAuth2/OpenID Connect provider discovery, OAuth2 authorization and token endpoints, client registration, and handling OAuth2 callbacks. It appears to be part of an experimental MCP server proxy implementation with features supporting PKCE and request URL reconstruction behind proxies.

classes.name: MCPServer
classes.description: A class representing an MCP server configuration and state, imported from litellm.types.mcp_server.mcp_server_manager, used for managing details like URLs, client IDs, secrets, authorization scopes, and auth types.

methods.name: str get_request_base_url(request: Request)
methods.description: Reconstructs the base URL of an incoming request, considering X-Forwarded-* headers set by proxies, to determine the original request URL.

methods.name: str encode_state_with_base_url( base_url: str, original_state: str, code_challenge: Optional[str] = None, code_challenge_method: Optional[str] = None, client_redirect_uri: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Serializes and encrypts OAuth2 state parameters along with the base URL, PKCE code challenge, and redirect URI to maintain session state across redirects.

methods.name: dict decode_state_hash(encrypted_state: str)
methods.description: Decrypts and deserializes the encrypted OAuth2 state information to retrieve stored session parameters.

methods.name: authorize_with_server( request: Request, mcp_server: MCPServer, client_id: str, redirect_uri: str, state: str = "", code_challenge: Optional[str] = None, code_challenge_method: Optional[str] = None, response_type: Optional[str] = None, scope: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs an OAuth2 authorization request URL with proper parameters, including PKCE support, and returns a redirect response to initiate authorization.

methods.name: exchange_token_with_server( request: Request, mcp_server: MCPServer, grant_type: str, code: Optional[str], redirect_uri: Optional[str], client_id: str, client_secret: Optional[str], code_verifier: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Performs an OAuth2 token exchange by posting authorization code and PKCE verifier to the token endpoint and returns the tokens as a JSON response.

methods.name: register_client_with_server( request: Request, mcp_server: MCPServer, client_name: str, grant_types: Optional[list], response_types: Optional[list], token_endpoint_auth_method: Optional[str], fallback_client_id: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Registers a new OAuth2 client with the server, handling fallbacks if registration is not enabled, and returns client credentials.

methods.name: authorize( request: Request, client_id: str, redirect_uri: str, state: str = "", mcp_server_name: Optional[str] = None, code_challenge: Optional[str] = None, code_challenge_method: Optional[str] = None, response_type: Optional[str] = None, scope: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: FastAPI route handler that initiates OAuth2 authorization flow by retrieving the MCP server and redirecting to its authorization URL.

methods.name: token_endpoint( request: Request, grant_type: str = Form(...), code: str = Form(None), redirect_uri: str = Form(None), client_id: str = Form(...), client_secret: Optional[str] = Form(None), code_verifier: str = Form(None), mcp_server_name: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: FastAPI route handler that exchanges an authorization code for an access token with the MCP server.

methods.name: callback(code: str, state: str)
methods.description: Handles OAuth2 callback, decodes and verifies the state, and redirects back to the original client URL with code and state parameters.

methods.name: oauth_protected_resource_mcp( request: Request, mcp_server_name: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Provides discovery information for an MCP OAuth protected resource, including authorization server URLs.

methods.name: oauth_authorization_server_mcp( request: Request, mcp_server_name: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Returns OAuth 2.0 discovery endpoints such as issuer, authorization_endpoint, token_endpoint, and supported features.

methods.name: openid_configuration(request: Request)
methods.description: Provides a standard OpenID configuration endpoint, aliasing the OAuth authorization server discovery info.

methods.name: oauth_authorization_server_root( request: Request, mcp_server_name: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Alias route for OAuth 2.0 discovery information.

methods.name: register_client(request: Request, mcp_server_name: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Registers a new client with the MCP server if registration is supported; otherwise returns dummy credentials.
